entry_rationale: Sidecar has no CORRA position, so this is a new OPEN rather than an ADD. Size matches the existing 25 million AONIA line: enough for duration-1 implied-rate P&L to matter versus SOFR on 250k of shocked risk, with most of the 10 million risk-capital cap unspent because energy pass-through can still overwhelm.
entry_thesis: The packet still pays the receiver for unused policy tightening that cash has not delivered. The widest eligible unused gap is Canada: cash CORRA 2.26 versus Mar27 2.995, a 73.5bp path premium, while September underlying inflation is 1.85 and labor is cooling. Triple-digit oil and a rising Canada oil-pressure proxy are known energy facts, not a cash-rate or reaction-function change, so they do not overwhelm the carry or justify staying out of the Canadian receive. Existing AONIA Mar27 remains a working, thinner 19bp receive and is held; new Australian risk is not added.

invalidation: Exit if cash CORRA rises from 2.26 toward 2.995 or if oil-driven Canadian inflation makes the Bank deliver the priced hikes.
